prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. One finished landscape 3:2 full-bleed picture-book illustration, one coherent scene and moment, no panels or contact sheet. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. Kit and Zoe have equal standing height. Include only characters needed by this exact scene, not every reference pose. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: Keep the Water in the Garden; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: An established vegetable bed in a school garden across three mornings, with an afternoon soil check between the first two. Zoe and Kit inspect with an adult gardener nearby, warm medium skin, short brown hair, plain green shirt and tan trousers.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): Established leafy vegetable plants; Brown soil; Clean straw mulch; Small blue watering can; Blunt trowel; Adult gardener
 Input references lock identity, prop design and location; compose a NEW image for the exact scene, never reproduce the reference-board layout. The reference and overall prop list may contain finished objects and later story events: these are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not permission to show them now. Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.
Page 10. Printed prose (NOT text to put in art): Leaves stand above the covering of straw. The children have saved water by keeping it useful, without leaving the plants thirsty.
Required illustration: Final wide garden view shows healthy leafy vegetables, even straw cover, dry path and blue can resting at gate. Exact continuity: No miraculous overnight growth; adult gardener nearby; conservation supported by observed soil state.
Exact current state: No miraculous overnight growth; adult gardener nearby; conservation supported by observed soil state.
Do not add later events, duplicate props or a separate inset. No written title; the app renders live text.
FINAL EXACT SCENE CONSTRAINTS: Final wide garden: Kit and Zoe see same healthy leafy plants, thin straw away from stems, gray path LEFT dry, ONE blue can RESTS at wooden gate BACK RIGHT. Adult gardener nearby. No watering, no miraculous size increase.
REFERENCE BOARD is design only: never copy multiple specimen poses, stage lineups or white reference-board layout into the scene. Use bold clean clear 2D cartoon, continuous strong dark outlines and flat clean colors, at most simple smooth cel shadows. No painterly texture, grain, stippling, photorealism, 3D or text.
GARDEN CARE BLOCKING: All humans keep feet/knees OUTSIDE planted bed, on gray path or grass beside its wooden border. No one stands or kneels on planted soil or straw. They reach over the low border naturally. Preserve hands and arm counts exactly; no duplicates.

visualReview.note: Final established leafy plants above even straw with stem gaps, dry path, one blue can rests by gate; all three people outside bed, no sudden growth.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image/sequence inspection; not physical classroom observation.
